answer: Assembling that for 48 aliases means 48 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Because each grove escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the zenith ledger records every share and the mirror audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 27 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
